caption: The plan page of the app Dynasort in the Shopify admin of our development store, scrolled down. The banner says Try any plan free for 30 days, you pay $0 today, with the first charge on December 17, 2026. Four plan cards follow: Demo (Free; 2 sorted collections, 2 managed collections, 60 min processing schedule, Customers Also Bought recipes no, device analytics no, button Go Demo), Basic ($99/mo crossed out, $49/mo; 25 sorted collections, 30 min schedule), Pro ($249/mo crossed out, $124/mo; 100 sorted collections, 20 min schedule) and Enterprise ($499/mo crossed out, $249/mo; 1000 sorted collections, 10 min schedule), each paid plan with the button Start free trial and the text 30 Day Free Trial.

The collection Automated Collection (a smart collection with the conditions price below US$800,00 and above US$200,00) in the Shopify admin before the test: Collection items 8, with the sort choice Most relevant and the first products shown in the Shopify order (The Collection Snowboard: Liquid, The Complete Snowboard, The Multi-managed Snowboard, The Multi-location Snowboard and more).

The product list of the collection Automated Collection inside Dynasort, with the recipe Dynasort Default on the right: Sales (Last 30 Days) (100), Sales (All Time) (50), Inventory Quantity (50), Sold Out (-100), On Sale (-20) and Variants In Stock (100), Product boost Inactive, Tie Breaker Best selling and Sold out items Move to bottom. The list shows the order and score of each product: 1 The Multi-location Snowboard (score 150), 2 The Multi-managed Snowboard (150), 3 The Complete Snowboard (127), 4 The Collection Snowboard: Liquid (127), 5 The Archived Snowboard.

The page of Automated Collection in Dynasort after the status was set: the label Active, the box Dynasort Status set to Active and the line Sorting 1 minute ago, with the buttons Edit in Shopify admin, View, Export and Sync now, the message Nice work, this part is done with Back to Guided Setup, and the Insights block (Last 1 Day) with conversion, add to cart, exit and bounce rate all at 0%.
